questions.question: Which of Laban's daughters did Jacob love and want to marry?
How did Laban deceive Jacob on his wedding night?
options: He hid Rachel far away from the feast
He drove off Jacob's best flocks
He kept on changing the agreed wages
He gave him Leah instead of Rachel
questions.answer: He gave him Leah instead of Rachel

questions.question: Jacob's seven years of work for Rachel seemed like only a few days because of his love for her.
Leah named her fourth son _____, saying, "This time I will praise the LORD."
